about: Pre-order Bonus: - Norgan Fashion Set - Northern Attire Note: May also be available at a later date.
This item is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma 2 and the Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion.
- Dragon's Dogma 2 can be played immediately.
- Dragon's Dogma 2 Explorer's Camping Kit - Camping Gear can be downloaded and used immediately.
- Dragon's Dogma 2 Dragon's Dogma Music & Sound Collection - Custom Sounds can be downloaded and used immediately.

- Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion will be available on October 9th, 2026 - Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Norgan Fashion Set - Northern Attire will be available on October 9th, 2026 Note: Items in this set can also be purchased separately.
